reviews.reason: The primary CIF is valid: it parses and symmetry-expands in primitive P2_1/m to 14 fully occupied atoms (Ti2Cr2Ag2S8, Z=2) in the stated 5.9582 x 3.4843 x 12.8186 A, beta=90.971 degree cell, with sensible complete coordination shells, no overlaps, charge balance, and bond-valence assignment Ag(+1)/Ti(+4)/Cr(+3)/S(-2). Indexing and line coverage are strong (20/20 DICVOL lines, M(20)=148.9; independently, all 90 peaks of prominence >=0.5 are within 0.013 degree of a CIF line), and the instantiated atomic model has real whole-profile support (independent R_profile about 4.10% versus a same-position Pawley bound about 3.86%, consistent with the trace's about 5.4% result). However, the exact Ti/Cr ordering is not exhausted: the trace enumerates six assignments on the four parent metal positions but submits only the two P2_1/m whole-site swaps. A full-occupancy mate-split ordering that lowers the refined model to Pm (corresponding to the unsubmitted P2/m/Cm parent choices) preserves the same indexed cell, composition, and plausible octahedral chemistry and gives an essentially comparable whole-profile fit (R_profile about 4.14%); its diagnostic ordering-only reflection such as 010 is only about 0.075% of the pattern maximum, below the profile noise. This is a concrete diffraction-compatible realization absent from the submitted set.

The submitted set contains a sufficiently established ordered realization. The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands in the already primitive P2_1/m cell (a=5.9582, b=3.4843, c=12.8186 A, beta=90.971 degrees) to 14 fully occupied atoms, Ti2Cr2Ag2S8 (Z=2), with the stated Ti/Cr/Ag ordering. Indexing is strong (20/20 DICVOL lines, M(20)=148.9), and all 90 observed peaks of prominence >=0.5 are within 0.013 degrees of an instantiated primary-CIF line, with no important unexplained reflection. Atomic-coordinate evidence is decisive rather than positional only: the trace reports comparable whole-profile residuals near 4.9-5.4%, and an independent fixed-line audit gives R_profile=4.57% versus a same-position Pawley lower bound of 4.07%; restoring the unrefined ideal parent coordinates worsens R_profile to 23.35%. The primary has no overlaps (minimum contact 2.358 A), complete TiS6/CrS6 and AgS6 shells, charge-balanced bond-valence assignments Ti(+4), Cr(+3), Ag(+1), S(-2), and sensible periodic topology. The four standardized CIFs are distinct and explicitly cover the two P2_1/m and two domain-collapsed Pm Ti/Cr-ordering motifs; relocating Ag from its submitted orbit is quantitatively rejected (best alternative R_profile >=46.25%). Thus the diffraction-relevant ordering/symmetry ambiguity is covered, and no concrete incompatible viable framework or superstructure survives to justify another attempt.
